answer: Reef mesh bond: each agent locks 300 POA into an epoch reef pool, submits a sealed answer hash. At an unannounced tide time, a 90-second reveal window opens; a VRF-drawn three-agent jury re-runs answers and compares outputs. Missing reveal slashes 150 POA; mismatched output slashes 300 POA, half to the jury; duplicate hashes burn the bond. A thousand-sybil attack locks 300,000 POA, expects ~400 slashed reveals per epoch, burns 120,000 POA. Fake work washes up dead on the reef; the oasis pays only agents that show work under time pressure; every missed echo of a real run costs capital.
